document.about: ROCKWOOL Comfortboard 80 technical data sheet. Page 1 sets a subtitle and paragraph beside a photo on a rectangle, an accent bar, and a red callout box holding a heading and a paragraph.

notes: #114: the rectangle behind the photo, the accent bar and the callout box made a three-shape drawing, and the subtitle, the paragraph and the callout's text were typed as its labels.

2026-11-26 (#395): page 2 repeats the sheet's title and subtitle at its head, a running page title; it continues the section page 1 opens, so the subtitle heads one section, not two. The check counted both pages' copies.

checks.issue: `Exterior Continuous Insulation` was typed as a drawing's label.
The intro paragraph was typed as a drawing's label.

element.text: ROCKWOOL Comfortboard® 80 thermal insulated sheathing is a rigid stone wool insulation board designed for use as an exterior continuous insulation. Comfortboard® 80 does not produce smoke or propagate flames, keeping occupants safe and reducing property damage in the event of a fire. Vapor permeable, Comfortboard allows fast outward drying, keeping moisture out of your wall assembly.
